servers.name: com.browser-use/browser-use

with: frey 0.9.2 (2026-11-13 build) on Windows 11 with Chrome 157 and DeepSeek V4 Flash

servers.notes: Drives a web browser: the model writes Python that runs in browser-use's session over the Chrome DevTools protocol (4 tools: browser_exec, browser_screenshot, browser_login, browser_feedback; about 680 tokens per request in Frey). Pinned at 1.0.3: it changes fast and asks to be pinned; the registry still lists 0.13.11, so write this connector entry rather than the registry's package. Two things to know: it drives the Chrome you are signed in to (when remote debugging is on there; otherwise a Chromium of its own on a temp profile), and it is not a sandbox: the code the model writes runs on this machine with your permissions. It sends anonymous usage statistics unless told not to: ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=false (set here) or `browser-use telemetry disable`. Needs uv (Python 3.11+). Checked on Windows: through this connector a DeepSeek turn opened a page, clicked its link and read the result in 7 to 10 requests; the same through its skill and command line took 14 to 16 requests, and Playwright MCP 0.0.85 offers 25 tools (about 4,900 tokens per request).
